implementation_summary: DEC-008: replaced the static SHARED_PAGE_CSP/SHARED_PAGE_HEADERS with sharedPageHeaders(html), which sets the Content-Security-Policy from previewCspForHtml(html) per response (sha256 of the page's own style elements, img-src data:, no unsafe-inline) and keeps all other /s/ headers. SEC-002: AuditShareDeps gains caller; listShares now checks mayUseAudit(view) (404 otherwise) and omits link ids from the reply for a non-owner Helper, leaving the owner reply unchanged. REVIEW-003 noted only: the duplicated screenshot-embedding code in audit-export.ts is outside this task's ownership.
tests_proposed: Check in QA that the rendered Pitch Glimpse and message pages show no CSP violations in a real browser (inline style attributes would be blocked by hash-only style-src).
evidence: packages/runner/tests/audit-share-routes.test.ts: expectSharedPageHeaders (no unsafe-inline, sha256 of each served style), 'GET /api/audits/:id/share by a Helper (SEC-002)'
risks: The Pitch Glimpse renderer may emit inline style attributes. Hash-only style-src does not cover them, so they would be blocked; not checked here.
Helper listShares reply omits `id`, which the ShareLink type requires. The reply is cast, since packages/types is outside this task's ownership.
tsc --noEmit in packages/runner reports previewCspForHtml as missing from @qa/core, probably a stale core build. Source and vitest are fine; run pnpm build first.
A Helper without a view grant now gets 404 from listShares, not an empty list.
handoff: BE-190: auditShareRoutes(deps) now requires deps.caller (context => AuditCaller), the same as the preview and shortlist rows. Pass the same caller reader. SHARED_PAGE_CSP and SHARED_PAGE_HEADERS no longer exist; use sharedPageHeaders(html) if needed. REVIEW-003: the screenshot-embedding duplication with audit-export.ts is untouched and can be refactored into a shared helper by whoever owns audit-export.ts.
